limits: Offline refits on old observed synthetic streams, no new online policy executions or new blind test data.
20 seeds are training-subset randomizations; same108 streams/36 multisets reused.
At full size all20 seeds use identical data; they do not provide20 independent replications.
Oracle is only hindsight minimum of two fixed branches after identical BF500 prefix, not optimal bin packing.
Nonmonotonic family-holdout outcome prevents claiming more training data always helps.
